## Overview

A tooltip is a small bubble that explains the thing it points at. One design and one token set serve web, iOS and Android. Typical MakeMyTrip uses: what "Free cancellation" covers on a hotel card, what a fee means in the fare summary, or a one-time hint that introduces a new filter.

There are two types:

- **Plain** is one short label, up to two lines, with nothing to tap inside. It explains an icon or a control and goes away by itself.
- **Rich** can hold media, a leading icon, a title, a message, a close button and a footer with a step count, a quiet secondary text action (such as Skip) and a primary text action (such as Next or Got it). Because it holds things to tap, it stays open until it is dismissed. Several Rich tooltips in a row make an onboarding tour.

Each type comes in three surfaces:

- **Dark** is a near-black bubble with no border or shadow. It is the default.
- **Light** is a white bubble with a hairline border and the overlay shadow. Use it over photos, maps and dark sections, or beside a strong brand surface where a near-black bubble would compete.
- **Info** is a light brand tint (`bg-surface-info`) with an info border and the overlay shadow. Use it for friendly tips and feature hints, such as a shortcut the user may not know. It is not for errors or warnings. On a grey page the tint all but disappears (1.02:1), so the border and shadow carry the edge.

The bubble sits on any **Side** of its trigger, with the **Caret** at the Start, Center or End of the edge that faces the trigger, or with no caret at all.

### When to use something else

| Situation | Use |
|---|---|
| Feedback about something the user just did, such as "Added to trip" | [Snackbar](snackbar.md) |
| A list of actions to choose from | [Menu](menu.md) |
| Content longer than a title and about three lines, a form, or more than two actions | A bottom sheet or dialog (not in Cosmos yet) |
| Information the user needs to finish the task, such as a fare rule that changes the price | Show it on the page. Never hide required information in a tooltip |
| A name for an icon-only button on touch | Give the button a visible label or an accessible name. A Plain tooltip on long-press supplements it on Android; it never replaces it |
| The value above a dragged slider thumb | Slider / Tooltip, inside [Slider](slider.md) |

### Composition

- **Tooltip** (`881:362`) is the bubble with its caret. Four variant axes: Type, Surface, Side and Caret, 96 variants.
- **Tooltip / Control** (`876:95`, constitutive) holds the two text actions and the close button of a Rich tooltip. Type (Primary, Secondary, Close) x Surface x State, 36 variants. All three are nested in every Rich variant, on the matching surface, and exposed.

The footer uses text actions, not the Cosmos Button. A tooltip floats over a screen that already has its own primary action, so a filled button would compete with it, and the Button has no style that passes on the Dark surface. This follows the Material 3 rich tooltip and Apple TipKit, which also use text actions.
- **Icon / auto-awesome** (`876:28`, referenced) is the default leading icon, swappable through the `Icon` property. **Icon / close** (`55:17`) is the close glyph.

## Platforms

| | Web | iOS | Android |
|---|---|---|---|
| Plain opens | Hover on the trigger after 300 ms, or keyboard focus with no delay. On touch screens, a tap on the trigger | A tap on the trigger, usually an info icon | A tap on an info trigger, or a long-press on an icon button (the Material convention) |
| Plain closes | The pointer leaves both the trigger and the bubble, blur, or Esc. It stays open while the pointer is over the bubble (WCAG 1.4.13) | A tap anywhere, a scroll, or after 4 s | A tap anywhere, a scroll, or after 4 s |
| Rich opens | A click on the trigger, Enter or Space on it, or automatically for an onboarding step | A tap on the trigger, or automatically for an onboarding step | A tap on the trigger, or automatically for an onboarding step |
| Rich closes | The close button, an action, a click outside, or Esc. Focus returns to the trigger | The close button, an action, or a tap outside | The close button, an action, a tap outside, or system Back |
| Edge spacing | At least `viewport-margin` (8) from the viewport edge | At least `screen-margin` (16) from the safe area | At least `screen-margin` (16) from the safe area |
| Hit area | Trigger, Skip and close at least 24 x 24 (WCAG 2.5.8); `min-touch-target` (48) on touch screens | 44 x 44 pt at least; `min-touch-target` (48) covers it | `min-touch-target` (48) dp |
| Hover and focus states | Yes | Focus only, with a hardware keyboard | Focus only, with a hardware keyboard |
| Base | A positioned layer, for example Floating UI or the Popover API with CSS anchor positioning | A custom overlay anchored to the trigger. `.popover` with `presentationCompactAdaptation(.popover)` (iOS 16.4+) works for Rich if its native arrow is acceptable | Material 3 `TooltipBox` with `PlainTooltip` and `RichTooltip` (`isPersistent = true` for Rich), with Cosmos tokens replacing the Material colours, shapes and padding |

Only one tooltip is open at a time; opening another closes the first. A tooltip never opens on page load, except a Rich onboarding step, which shows once per user and is remembered once dismissed.

## API

> `side` and `caret` are the preferred placement. In code the tooltip flips to the opposite side when there is no room, then shifts along the edge to stay inside the margins, with the caret still aimed at the centre of the trigger.

| Property | Type | Values | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `type` | enum | plain \| rich | `plain` | Rich is persistent and may hold interactive content; Plain may not. |
| `surface` | enum | dark \| light \| info | `dark` | Light over imagery and dark sections; Info for friendly tips and feature hints. |
| `side` | enum | top \| bottom \| left \| right | `top` | Where the bubble sits relative to the trigger. Left and right mirror in right-to-left layouts. |
| `caret` | enum | center \| start \| end \| none | `center` | Where the caret sits along the edge facing the trigger. Start and End are the left and right ends of a Top or Bottom tooltip in left-to-right layouts, and the top and bottom ends of a Left or Right tooltip. None hides the caret but keeps the bubble in place. |
| `label` | string | (string) | – | Plain text. |
| `title` | string | (string) | – | Rich only. Optional. |
| `message` | string | (string) | – | Rich only. Required. |
| `icon` | icon | (glyph) | none | Rich only. Optional leading glyph, level with the title. |
| `media` | image | (image) | none | Rich only. Optional image or illustration across the top, 2:1. |
| `step` | `{ current, total }` | – | none | Rich only. Shows "1 of 3" in the footer for an onboarding tour. |
| `secondaryAction` | `{ label, onAction }` | – | none | Rich only. A quiet text action, such as Skip. |
| `primaryAction` | `{ label, onAction }` | – | none | Rich only. A blue text action, such as Next, Done or Got it. Never "OK" or "Close"; use `showClose` instead. |
| `showClose` | boolean | true \| false | `true` | Rich only. Hide it only when an action already dismisses, such as Got it. A Rich tooltip always has at least one way to close. |
| `open`, `onOpenChange` | boolean, callback | – | – | Controlled open state, for onboarding steps. |
| `delay` | number | ms | `300` | Web hover delay for Plain. Focus opens with no delay. |
| `duration` | number | ms | `4000` | Auto-dismiss for Plain on touch. Rich never auto-dismisses. |

### Figma-only properties

| Figma property | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Type` | VARIANT | Plain | Plain or Rich. |
| `Surface` | VARIANT | Dark | Dark, Light or Info. |
| `Side` | VARIANT | Top | Top, Bottom, Left, Right: where the bubble sits relative to its trigger, so Top has the caret on its bottom edge, pointing down. |
| `Caret` | VARIANT | Center | Center, Start, End, None. |
| `Label` | TEXT | `"Label"` | Plain only. |
| `Title`, `Message`, `Step` | TEXT | `"Title"`, `"Message"`, `"Step"` | Rich only. |
| `Show media` | BOOLEAN | `false` | Rich only. Replace the Media fill with an image in your mock. |
| `Show icon` | BOOLEAN | `false` | Rich only. |
| `Icon` | INSTANCE_SWAP | Icon / auto-awesome | Rich only. |
| `Show title`, `Show close`, `Show footer` | BOOLEAN | `true` | Rich only. Show footer hides the whole footer row. |
| `Show step`, `Show secondary action`, `Show primary action` | BOOLEAN | `true` | Rich only, inside the footer. |
| `Close`, `Secondary action`, `Primary action` | Nested instance | exposed | Set their `State` and `Label` from the Tooltip panel. |

Tooltip / Control has `Type` (Primary, Secondary, Close), `Surface` (Dark, Light, Info), `State` (Default, Hover, Pressed, Focus) and a `Label` text property. State is design-only: in code it comes from `:hover`, `:active` and `:focus-visible` on web and from the press state on mobile.

Every variant ships placeholder copy. Realistic copy lives in the `Tooltip examples` frame (`885:330`).

In every scene the caret tip sits exactly `offset` (4) from its trigger, and the bubble stays inside the margins.

## Behaviour

- **One at a time.** Opening a tooltip closes any other.
- **Hoverable (web).** Moving the pointer from the trigger onto a Plain bubble keeps it open, so its text can be read and selected. A 100 ms grace period covers the gap.
- **Never essential.** Anything the user must know to finish the task is on the page. A tooltip adds context; it never holds the only copy.
- **Placement and collision.** The tooltip prefers its `side`. When it would cross the margin it flips to the opposite side, then shifts along the edge. The caret keeps pointing at the centre of the trigger and never gets closer than `caret-inset` to the bubble edge. If the trigger scrolls out of view, the tooltip closes.
- **Scroll.** On mobile a scroll closes a Plain tooltip. A Rich tooltip follows its trigger and closes once the trigger leaves the screen.
- **Text.** Plain wraps at `max-width` (240); copy that needs more than two lines belongs in Rich. Rich wraps at `rich-max-width` (320). Text never truncates.
- **Onboarding tour.** Each step is a Rich tooltip with `step`. The primary action moves to the next step ("Next"), and reads "Done" on the last. Skip ends the tour. Remember the tour once it ends or is skipped.
- **Font scaling.** With Dynamic Type or Android font scaling the width stays capped and the bubble grows taller. At the largest sizes on a small phone a Rich tooltip may fill the width minus `screen-margin` on each side.
- **Right-to-left.** Start and End mirror, Left and Right swap, and the close button and footer mirror.
- **Trigger.** On touch the trigger is usually an info icon or a text link with a dotted underline. Give it `min-touch-target` of hit area, even when the icon is 16.

### Motion (not tokenised yet)

- **Enter:** fade from 0 to 1 and slide 4 px from the trigger towards the final position, over 150 ms ease-out.
- **Exit:** fade out over 100 ms ease-in, without moving.
- **Reduce Motion:** fade only.

## Structure

### Anatomy

```text
Tooltip (component set · 881:362 · Type x Surface x Side x Caret = 96 variants)
├─ Bubble (auto layout)
│  ├─ Plain: Label (text · body/small/regular, 12 / 16 · fills and wraps) · padding 8 x 12 · radius 8 · hugs up to max width 240
│  └─ Rich: vertical, gap 12 · padding 12 · radius 12 · 320 wide
│     ├─ Media (2:1, radius 8, media-bg fill) · Show media
│     └─ Body (vertical, gap 16, fills)
│        ├─ Header (horizontal, gap 8, top-aligned)
│        │  ├─ Icon (instance · 20) · Show icon · Icon swap
│        │  ├─ Text (vertical, gap 2, fills)
│        │  │  ├─ Title (text · title/small/bold, 14 / 20) · Show title
│        │  │  └─ Message (text · body/small/regular, 12 / 16)
│        │  └─ Close (exposed instance · Tooltip / Control, Close) · Show close
│        └─ Footer (horizontal, gap 8, centred, right-aligned) · Show footer
│           ├─ Step (text · label/small/regular, 12 / 16 · fills) · Show step
│           ├─ Secondary action (exposed instance · Tooltip / Control, Secondary) · Show secondary action
│           └─ Primary action (exposed instance · Tooltip / Control, Primary) · Show primary action
└─ Caret row (Top and Bottom) or Caret column (Left and Right) · 7 deep, overlapping the bubble by 1
   └─ Caret (12 x 7, or 7 x 12) · inset caret-inset at Start or End · absent with Caret None
      ├─ Fill (vector in the bubble colour; its 1 px base strip covers the bubble border under the caret)
      └─ Edge (Light and Info · one open stroke, border-light, border-width, mitred: it runs 1 px along the bubble border on each side, then round the caret, so the outline never breaks)

Tooltip / Control (component set · 876:95 · Type x Surface x State = 36 variants)
├─ Focus Ring (absolute, 4 outside the control, radius 12) · Focus only
└─ Primary or Secondary: Label (text · label/small/bold, 12 / 16) · 32 tall · padding 0 x 8 · radius 8
   or Close: Icon (instance · Icon / close · 16) · 24 x 24 · radius 8
```

The caret row comes after the bubble for Top and Left, and before it for Bottom and Right. Bottom and Right reverse the stacking order so the caret is drawn over the bubble. With Caret None the empty row stays, so the bubble does not move when the caret is turned off.

## Color

Token names follow `tooltip/{part}-{surface}[-{state}]`, with `dark`, `light` or `info` as the surface.

| Element | Dark | Light | Info |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bubble and caret | `bg-dark` → `bg-surface-inverse` #0A0A0A | `bg-light` → `bg-surface-secondary` #FFFFFF | `bg-info` → `bg-surface-info` #EDFAFF |
| Border | none | `border-light` → `border-secondary` #E5E5E5 | `border-info` → `border-info` #83DFFF |
| Shadow | none | `shadow-light` → `shadow.overlay` | `shadow-info` → `shadow.overlay` |
| Plain label and Rich title | `label-dark` → `text-inverse` #FFFFFF | `label-light` → `text-primary` #0A0A0A | `label-info` → `text-primary` #0A0A0A |
| Rich message and step | `description-dark` → `text-inverse-secondary` #A1A1A1 | `description-light` → `text-secondary` #525252 | `description-info` → `text-secondary` #525252 |
| Leading icon | `icon-dark` → `icon-inverse` #FFFFFF | `icon-light` → `icon` #0A0A0A | `icon-info` → `icon-info` #0088FF |
| Media placeholder | `media-bg-dark` → `bg-fill-inverse-pressed` #262626 | `media-bg-light` → `bg-surface` #F5F5F5 | `media-bg-info` → `bg-surface-secondary` #FFFFFF |
| Primary action label | `primary-label-dark` → `text-link-inverse` #83DFFF, every state | `primary-label-light` → `text-brand` #0088FF; Hover `-hover` → `text-brand-on-bg-fill-subtlest-hover` #0868C5; Pressed `-pressed` → `text-brand-on-bg-fill-subtlest-pressed` #0D589B | `primary-label-info` → `text-info` #0088FF; Hover `-hover` → `text-info-on-bg-fill-subtlest-hover` #0868C5; Pressed `-pressed` → `text-info-on-bg-fill-subtlest-pressed` #0D589B |
| Secondary action label | `secondary-label-dark` → `text-inverse-secondary` #A1A1A1 | `secondary-label-light` → `text-secondary` #525252 | `secondary-label-info` → `text-secondary` #525252 |
| Close glyph | `close-icon-dark` → `icon-inverse-secondary` #A1A1A1 | `close-icon-light` → `icon-secondary` #525252 | `close-icon-info` → `icon-secondary` #525252 |
| Text actions and close, Hover | `control-bg-dark-hover` → `bg-fill-inverse-hover` #171717 | `control-bg-light-hover` → `bg-fill-brand-subtlest` #EDFAFF | `control-bg-info-hover` → `bg-fill-info-subtlest-hover` #D6F3FF |
| Text actions and close, Pressed | `control-bg-dark-pressed` → `bg-fill-inverse-pressed` #262626 | `control-bg-light-pressed` → `bg-fill-brand-subtlest-hover` #D6F3FF | `control-bg-info-pressed` → `bg-fill-info-subtlest-pressed` #B5EAFF |
| Focus ring | `focus-ring` → `border-focus` #0088FF | same | same |

At rest and on focus the text actions and close button have no fill; only hover and press add one. On Light that fill is a light brand tint, the same as a Text Button. On Light and Info the primary label darkens with the fill, because the brand and info blues fall to 3.03 and 2.71:1 on the tinted Info hover and pressed fills; on Dark the light blue passes on every fill, so it stays the same. The message keeps the description colour with or without a title.

This component adds no semantic roles.

### Semantics

| | Web | iOS / VoiceOver | Android / TalkBack |
|---|---|---|---|
| Plain | The bubble has `role="tooltip"` and an `id`; the trigger points at it with `aria-describedby`. It never takes focus. Esc closes it without moving focus | The tooltip text is the trigger `.accessibilityHint`, so VoiceOver reads "Fee info, button. Charged per traveller for booking online." The bubble itself is hidden from VoiceOver | `TooltipBox` makes the tooltip the trigger description, read after its label. The bubble is not focusable |
| Rich | The trigger has `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`. The bubble is a non-modal dialog (`role="dialog"`, `aria-labelledby` the title, or `aria-label` without one). Opened from the trigger, focus moves into it; on close it returns to the trigger. Tab order: secondary action, primary action, close | Post `.screenChanged` with the bubble, so VoiceOver reads the title and message. The close button is "Close, button" and comes last. The escape gesture closes it | The bubble is a pane (`paneTitle` = the title) and takes TalkBack focus on open. Back closes it and returns focus to the trigger |
| Onboarding step | Shown automatically, it does not take focus; it is announced once through a polite live region, and the trigger stays the focus. The step count is part of the accessible name, such as "Step 1 of 3, New: Filter by airline" | Announced once with `.announcement`; focus moves to it only when the user opened it | Announced once; focus moves to it only when the user opened it |
| Trigger | A real `<button>` with an accessible name, such as "Fee info". Never a bare icon | `.accessibilityLabel`, plus `.isButton` | `contentDescription`, plus `Role.Button` |
| Media and icon | Decorative: `alt=""` unless the image carries meaning the text does not | `.accessibilityHidden(true)` when decorative | `contentDescription = null` when decorative |

A Plain tooltip never holds a link or a button, because a pointer or screen reader user cannot reach it before it closes. Anything interactive makes it Rich.

## Platform mapping

| | Web | iOS (SwiftUI) | Android (Compose) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fill | `background: var(--tooltip-bg-dark)` | `.background(CosmosTokens.tooltipBgDark)` | `containerColor = CosmosTokens.tooltipBgDark` |
| Padding | `padding: var(--tooltip-padding-y) var(--tooltip-padding-x)` | `.padding(.vertical, CosmosTokens.tooltipPaddingY).padding(.horizontal, CosmosTokens.tooltipPaddingX)` | `Modifier.padding(horizontal = CosmosTokens.tooltipPaddingX, vertical = CosmosTokens.tooltipPaddingY)` |
| Shape | `border-radius: var(--tooltip-radius)` | `RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: CosmosTokens.tooltipRadius)` | `shape = RoundedCornerShape(CosmosTokens.tooltipRadius)` |
| Light shadow | `box-shadow: var(--tooltip-shadow-light)` | Two `.shadow` modifiers from `tooltipShadowLight1*` and `tooltipShadowLight2*` | Two layers from `tooltipShadowLight1*` and `tooltipShadowLight2*` |
| Caret | One path for bubble and caret, or a CSS `clip-path` triangle `var(--tooltip-caret-width)` wide | A `Path` triangle in the bubble fill, with the Light border stroked on its outer sides | `caretSize = DpSize(CosmosTokens.tooltipCaretWidth, CosmosTokens.tooltipCaretWidth / 2)` on `PlainTooltip` and `RichTooltip` |

```css
.tooltip[data-surface="dark"] {
  background: var(--tooltip-bg-dark);
  color: var(--tooltip-label-dark);
  padding: var(--tooltip-padding-y) var(--tooltip-padding-x);
  border-radius: var(--tooltip-radius);
  max-width: var(--tooltip-max-width);
}
.tooltip[data-surface="light"] {
  background: var(--tooltip-bg-light);
  color: var(--tooltip-label-light);
  border: var(--tooltip-border-width) solid var(--tooltip-border-light);
  box-shadow: var(--tooltip-shadow-light);
}
.tooltip[data-type="rich"] {
  padding: var(--tooltip-rich-padding-y) var(--tooltip-rich-padding-x);
  border-radius: var(--tooltip-rich-radius);
  max-width: var(--tooltip-rich-max-width);
}
.tooltip[data-type="rich"] .tooltip__body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--tooltip-rich-gap-footer); }
```

## Known gaps

- **Hover is web-only.** The Tooltip / Control Hover variants apply to web.
- **Literal geometry in Figma.** Everything else binds to a variable. Three values do not: the -1 gap that tucks the caret under the bubble edge, the 7 px drawn depth of the caret row (6 visible plus the 1 px overlap), and the focus ring position (4 outside the control, which is `focus-ring-offset` plus `focus-ring-width`).
- **Rich width in Figma.** Rich is drawn at a fixed 320; in code it hugs its content up to 320.
- **Media is a placeholder.** The Media frame carries `media-bg-*`; replace its fill with an image in a mock.
- **Caret border on Light and Info.** Figma draws the caret over the bubble border, and a mitred Edge stroke rejoins the two so the outline is continuous. Its corner points sit at fractional positions worked out for a 1 px border and a 12 x 6 caret; if `border-width` or `caret-width` changes, redraw the Edge. In code, draw the bubble and caret as one path.
- **No motion tokens.** Durations and easing are documented above, not tokenised.
- **No dark theme.** All variable collections are single-mode. In a future dark theme the Light and Info surfaces are the ones to adapt.
- **Info under test.** Info is a trial surface beside Dark and Light. If it is dropped, delete the `*-info` tokens (14 with the primary action labels), the Info variants of both sets and the Info example.
- **Not uSpec-generated.** This file is hand-authored next to the Figma build.

## Token reference

69 tokens under `component.tooltip` in `tokens/tokens.json`. 67 are mirrored 1:1 as `tooltip/*` in the Figma `component` collection. The Figma file has no shadow variables, so `shadow-light` and `shadow-info` are the `shadow/overlay` effect style on the Light and Info variants there.

| Group | Count |
|---|---|
| Surface: `bg-dark`, `bg-light`, `bg-info`, `border-light`, `border-info`, `border-width`, `shadow-light`, `shadow-info` | 8 |
| Text: `label-dark`, `label-light`, `label-info`, `description-dark`, `description-light`, `description-info` | 6 |
| Rich parts: `icon-dark`, `icon-light`, `icon-info`, `icon-size`, `media-bg-dark`, `media-bg-light`, `media-bg-info`, `media-radius` | 8 |
| Controls: `primary-label-dark`, `primary-label-light`, `primary-label-light-hover`, `primary-label-light-pressed`, `primary-label-info`, `primary-label-info-hover`, `primary-label-info-pressed`, `secondary-label-dark`, `secondary-label-light`, `secondary-label-info`, `close-icon-dark`, `close-icon-light`, `close-icon-info`, `control-bg-dark-hover`, `control-bg-dark-pressed`, `control-bg-light-hover`, `control-bg-light-pressed`, `control-bg-info-hover`, `control-bg-info-pressed`, `control-height`, `control-padding-x`, `control-radius`, `close-size`, `close-icon-size` | 24 |
| Focus and touch: `focus-ring`, `focus-ring-width`, `focus-ring-offset`, `focus-ring-radius`, `min-touch-target` | 5 |
| Plain layout: `padding-x`, `padding-y`, `radius`, `max-width` | 4 |
| Rich layout: `rich-padding-x`, `rich-padding-y`, `rich-radius`, `rich-max-width`, `rich-gap-text`, `rich-gap-inline`, `rich-gap-section`, `rich-gap-footer`, `rich-gap-actions` | 9 |
| Caret and position: `caret-width`, `caret-inset`, `offset`, `screen-margin`, `viewport-margin` | 5 |

`max-width` aliases the primitive `spacing.240` and `rich-max-width` aliases `spacing.320`, because no `space.*` step reaches those widths.

Platform names follow the standard pipeline: `tooltip/bg-dark` → `--tooltip-bg-dark` (CSS) → `CosmosTokens.tooltipBgDark` (Swift and Kotlin) → `tokens.tooltip["bg-dark"]` (TS).
